description: Implement the scene system with multiple working visualizer modes. Each scene is a self-contained Three.js scene that receives AudioState and renders audio-reactive 3D content. Include at least 8 distinct visualizer modes covering different visual styles.
steps: Create src/scenes/types.ts - BaseScene interface with methods: init(renderer, audioState), update(deltaTime, audioState), resize(width, height), destroy(), getConfig(): SceneConfig. Define SceneConfig with name, description, category, thumbnail, configurable parameters
Create src/scenes/SceneManager.ts - manage scene lifecycle, handle transitions between scenes (crossfade, cut, zoom), maintain scene registry, support auto-transition on drops/buildups
Create src/scenes/registry.ts - registry of all available scenes with metadata for the UI to list them

Create src/scenes/CircularSpectrum.ts - classic circular spectrum analyzer: bars arranged in a circle, height driven by frequency, color gradient from bass (warm) to highs (cool), glow on beats, rotation speed linked to energy

Create src/scenes/TrapNationRing.ts - the iconic Trap Nation style ring visualizer: centered circle with radiating bars, reactive ring scale on bass, particle burst on beats, background gradient shift

Create src/scenes/ParticleGalaxy.ts - 50k+ particles in a spiral galaxy formation. Rotation speed linked to BPM, particle brightness to energy, arm spread to bass, color to frequency distribution. Camera slowly orbits

Create src/scenes/InfiniteTunnel.ts - camera moves through an infinite tunnel made of wireframe rings or geometric shapes. Tunnel radius pulses with bass, speed linked to energy, ring colors shift with frequency, fog density reactive
Create src/scenes/NeonWaveform.ts - 3D neon tube rendering of the audio waveform. Multiple layers at different depths, glow intensity linked to energy, color cycling with beat, camera slight movement

Create src/scenes/AudioTerrain.ts - procedural terrain mesh with vertices displaced by frequency spectrum. Camera flies over terrain. Height mapped from FFT, color from altitude (bass=deep, highs=peaks), fog and atmosphere

Create src/scenes/GeometricPulse.ts - polyhedra (icosahedron, dodecahedron) that pulse and morph with audio. Vertices displaced by frequency bands, wireframe and solid mix, rotation on beat, emission glow on energy
Create src/scenes/SpaceScene.ts - starfield background with nebula colors, central energy sphere pulsing with bass, orbiting particles, lens flares on peaks, volumetric rays on beats

Create src/scenes/CyberpunkCity.ts - simplified cityscape silhouette with neon lights reacting to audio. Building heights pulse with bass, neon signs flicker with highs, rain particles, reflective ground plane
Create src/scenes/ReactiveVortex.ts - spiraling vortex of particles pulled toward center, audio energy controls spiral tightness, beats cause expansion bursts, color gradient based on frequency
Create src/scenes/EnergyStorm.ts - lightning/energy bolts between points, frequency of bolts linked to beats, brightness to energy, branching complexity to spectral content
Create src/scenes/FluidSimulation.ts - simplified 2D fluid rendered as a fullscreen shader, velocity field driven by audio spectrum, color based on frequency bands, swirl intensity from bass
Create src/scenes/index.ts exporting all scenes and the scene registry
acceptance_criteria: SceneManager can load, transition, and destroy scenes
Each scene implements the BaseScene interface correctly
At least 12 distinct visualizer scenes are implemented
Scenes use actual Three.js objects (Mesh, Points, ShaderMaterial, etc.)
Scenes respond to AudioState properties in their update() methods
Scene registry provides metadata for all scenes
